title: Why a peacock's blue isn't pigment
caption:
A peacock's blue comes from structure, not blue pigment.

The same lattice of melanin rods makes every colour in the eyespot; blue, green, yellow and brown differ mainly in rod spacing and the number of layers.

Source: Zi J. et al. (2003) Coloration strategies in peacock feathers, PNAS 100:12576. Footage: Indian peafowl, Botanical Garden Hyderabad. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
